summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs` in package.json) downloads the Bun 1.3.13 runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into an OS temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array `n7gIxM` shifted at runtime by function `WV8StW`, hex-mangled single-character identifiers, sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc). The filename `math_init.js` does not correspond to any math/init functionality in the surrounding SDK source. Fetching a second language runtime at install time specifically to run an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based scanners; the fetched runtime executes attacker-authored code on the installer's machine on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
